description: KNa₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. K is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. All K-Cl bond lengths are 3.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are three shorter (2.81 Å) and three longer (2.82 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are three shorter (2.82 Å) and three longer (2.83 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to three equivalent K and three equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₃Na₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
